# f5xc_k8s_cluster_role (Resource)

K8s Cluster Role is K8s ClusterRole object, which represents set of permissions for<br>user, group or service account to which this role is assigned.

To get more information about f5xc_k8s_cluster_role, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/k8s-cluster-role)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: K8s Cluster Role - Basic

resource "f5xc_k8s_cluster_role" "example" {
  name      = "example-k8s-cluster-role"
  namespace = "system"

  rule_choice = {
    policy_rule_list = {
      policy_rule = [{
        resource_choice = {
          resource_list = {
            api_groups     = ["apps"]
            resource_types = ["deployments"]
            verbs          = ["get", "list"]
          }
        }
      }]
    }
  }
}
```

```terraform
# Example: K8s Cluster Role - Full

resource "f5xc_k8s_cluster_role" "example" {
  name        = "example-k8s-cluster-role"
  namespace   = "system"
  description = "K8s cluster role full example"

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "example-team"
  }

  rule_choice = {
    policy_rule_list = {
      policy_rule = [
        {
          resource_choice = {
            resource_list = {
              api_groups         = ["rbac.authorization.k8s.io"]
              resource_types     = ["roles"]
              resource_instances = ["admin"]
              verbs              = ["get", "watch"]
            }
          }
        },
        {
          resource_choice = {
            non_resource_url_list = {
              urls  = ["/healthz"]
              verbs = ["get"]
            }
          }
        },
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
